name: v2-tiny-segments
approved_by: Claude independent analytical review (scripted kinematic model; not physical-board)
review: Independent checks: at all 79 endpoints accumulated steps agree with commanded positions within 0.501 step (80 steps/mm), ending at (126,63,0). Total duration 0.2606 s against 0.264 s for the symmetric accelerate-decelerate model over the 1.744 mm commanded path (-1.3%). Per-block durations run 0-20% below a model using step-quantized lengths (1-2 steps per block) and 50% below for the final stop block; this is step quantization and is not treated as a defect. Two simulator runs gave identical traces. Not a physical-board measurement.
